```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- Weekly cutoff support (no more game_date-based drift) ---
# We need season/week (or game_id to derive them) to do "as-of week" averages.
if (!all(c("season","week") %in% names(data))) {
  if ("game_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        season = as.integer(substr(game_id, 1, 4)),
        week   = as.integer(substr(game_id, 6, 7))
      )
  } else {
    stop("Step 4 requires columns season & week (or game_id to derive them) for weekly cutoffs.")
  }
}

# Build a stable week_index across season/week, and add a placeholder next-week per season
week_map_all <- data %>%
  distinct(season, week) %>%
  filter(is.finite(season), is.finite(week), week >= 1L, week <= 22L) %>%
  arrange(season, week)

next_weeks <- week_map_all %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(week = max(week, na.rm = TRUE) + 1L, .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(is.finite(week), week >= 1L, week <= 22L)

week_map_all <- bind_rows(week_map_all, next_weeks) %>%
  distinct(season, week) %>%
  arrange(season, week) %>%
  mutate(week_index = row_number())

data <- data %>%
  left_join(week_map_all, by = c("season", "week"))

# Safety: if we couldn't map some rows to a (season, week) index, fail loudly.
if (any(is.na(data$week_index))) {
  bad <- data %>% filter(is.na(week_index)) %>% select(game_date, season, week, posteam, defteam) %>% head(10)
  print(bad)
  stop("Some rows are missing week_index. Ensure season/week (or game_id) are valid for all rows.")
}


# Weighted average helper
weighted_avg <- function(x, w) {
  sum(x * w, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# 14-game recency weights (most recent gets highest)
weights_14 <- c(
  0.093433333,
  0.091766667,
  0.0855,
  0.0823,
  0.0791,
  0.0759,
  0.0727,
  0.0695,
  0.0663,
  0.0631,
  0.0599,
  0.0567,
  0.0535,
  0.0503
)
stopifnot(length(weights_14) == 14L, abs(sum(weights_14) - 1) < 1e-9)
```





################################################################################################
### Team + League Averages (Weekly Cutoff, Recency Weights)
################################################################################################

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Helper: resolve week_index for an (season, week) "as-of" snapshot
get_week_index <- function(season_in, week_in, week_map = week_map_all) {
  idx <- week_map %>%
    filter(season == season_in, week == week_in) %>%
    pull(week_index)

  if (length(idx) != 1L || !is.finite(idx)) {
    stop("Could not resolve week_index for season=", season_in, " week=", week_in,
         ". Check that season/week exist (or placeholder week was added).")
  }
  idx[[1]]
}

# Core: last-14 PRIOR games for each team before (season, week), with recency weights applied.
# team_col should be "posteam" or "defteam".
build_last14_weighted <- function(team_col, season_in, week_in) {
  as_of <- get_week_index(season_in, week_in)

  df <- data %>%
    filter(week_index < as_of) %>%
    arrange(.data[[team_col]], desc(week_index), desc(game_date)) %>%
    group_by(.data[[team_col]]) %>%
    slice_head(n = 14) %>%
    mutate(
      rn = row_number(),
      w_raw = weights_14[rn],
      weight = w_raw / sum(w_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  df
}

# Posteam averages as-of (season, week)
posteam_week_avg <- function(season_in, week_in) {
  df <- build_last14_weighted("posteam", season_in, week_in)

  # numeric stat columns only (exclude bookkeeping + weight columns)
  num_cols <- df %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
  num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, c("season", "week", "week_index", "rn", "w_raw", "weight"))

  out <- df %>%
    group_by(posteam) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(num_cols), ~ weighted_avg(.x, weight)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(season = season_in, week = week_in)

  nm <- names(out)
  names(out) <- ifelse(nm %in% c("posteam", "season", "week"), nm, paste0("posteam_avg_", nm))
  out
}

# Defteam averages as-of (season, week)
defteam_week_avg <- function(season_in, week_in) {
  df <- build_last14_weighted("defteam", season_in, week_in)

  num_cols <- df %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
  num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, c("season", "week", "week_index", "rn", "w_raw", "weight"))

  out <- df %>%
    group_by(defteam) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(num_cols), ~ weighted_avg(.x, weight)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(season = season_in, week = week_in)

  nm <- names(out)
  names(out) <- ifelse(nm %in% c("defteam", "season", "week"), nm, paste0("defteam_avg_", nm))
  out
}

# League averages as-of (season, week):
# - compute weighted last-14 average for each team (posteam)
# - then take the mean across teams (equal-weight across teams)
league_week_avg <- function(season_in, week_in) {
  df <- build_last14_weighted("posteam", season_in, week_in)

  num_cols <- df %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
  num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, c("season", "week", "week_index", "rn", "w_raw", "weight"))

  team_means <- df %>%
    group_by(posteam) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(num_cols), ~ weighted_avg(.x, weight)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  out <- team_means %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(num_cols), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(season = season_in, week = week_in)

  nm <- names(out)
  names(out) <- ifelse(nm %in% c("season", "week"), nm, paste0("NFL_avg_", nm))
  out
}
```

### Build averages for all (season, week) snapshots (includes placeholder next week)
```{r}
library(dplyr)

season_week_list <- week_map_all %>%
  arrange(season, week)

data.last20.avg.off    <- data.frame()
data.last20.avg.def    <- data.frame()
data.last20.avg.league <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(season_week_list))) {
  s <- season_week_list$season[i]
  w <- season_week_list$week[i]

  data.last20.avg.off    <- bind_rows(data.last20.avg.off,    posteam_week_avg(s, w))
  data.last20.avg.def    <- bind_rows(data.last20.avg.def,    defteam_week_avg(s, w))
  data.last20.avg.league <- bind_rows(data.last20.avg.league, league_week_avg(s, w))
}

print(head(data.last20.avg.off))
print(head(data.last20.avg.def))
print(head(data.last20.avg.league))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export "as-of next week" snapshots (one per season)
#
# Why: Step 4.5 currently rolls averages forward by game_date. Without an explicit
# "next-week" snapshot, future games pick up the most-recent *played-week* averages,
# which are computed as-of that played week (and therefore exclude that week).
#
# Here we export a synthetic snapshot for each season at (max_week + 1), with an
# anchor game_date set to (max played game_date + 1 day). Step 4.5 can append these
# rows to its rolling source tables so Week (max_week+1) projections include the
# just-played week.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Identify next week per season (already computed above as `next_weeks`)
anchor_dates <- data %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(anchor_game_date = max(game_date, na.rm = TRUE) + 1, .groups = "drop")

asof_next_post <- data.last20.avg.off %>%
  semi_join(next_weeks, by = c("season", "week")) %>%
  left_join(anchor_dates, by = "season") %>%
  transmute(posteam, game_date = anchor_game_date, across(starts_with("posteam_avg_")))

asof_next_def <- data.last20.avg.def %>%
  semi_join(next_weeks, by = c("season", "week")) %>%
  left_join(anchor_dates, by = "season") %>%
  transmute(defteam, game_date = anchor_game_date, across(starts_with("defteam_avg_")))

asof_next_nfl <- data.last20.avg.league %>%
  semi_join(next_weeks, by = c("season", "week")) %>%
  left_join(anchor_dates, by = "season") %>%
  transmute(game_date = anchor_game_date, across(starts_with("NFL_avg_")))

save(
  asof_next_post,
  asof_next_def,
  asof_next_nfl,
  file = "../output/asof_next_week_avgs.RData"
)

readr::write_csv(asof_next_post, "../output/asof_next_week_posteam_avgs.csv")
readr::write_csv(asof_next_def,  "../output/asof_next_week_defteam_avgs.csv")
readr::write_csv(asof_next_nfl,  "../output/asof_next_week_nfl_avgs.csv")
```

### Merge averages back onto game rows (join by season/week instead of game_date)
```{r}
library(dplyr)

merged_data <- data %>%
  left_join(data.last20.avg.off,    by = c("posteam", "season", "week")) %>%
  left_join(data.last20.avg.def,    by = c("defteam", "season", "week")) %>%
  left_join(data.last20.avg.league, by = c("season", "week"))

# Replace NaN in numeric columns (if any) with column mean
reference_rows <- !is.na(merged_data$season) & merged_data$season < 2026
stopifnot(any(reference_rows))
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ {
    x <- .
    if (any(is.nan(x))) {
      replacement <- mean(x[reference_rows], na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.finite(replacement)) x[is.nan(x)] <- replacement
    }
    x
  }))

print(merged_data)
```

```{r}
save(merged_data, file = "../output/merged.data.sos.RData")
```
